faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is 02 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post in the NIFTEM Recruitment 2026. This is a project-based research opportunity at a national institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) posts is online. Interested candidates must fill out the application form through the official career portal of NIFTEM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) at NIFTEM?
faq.answer: The selected Senior Research Fellow (SRF) at NIFTEM will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000 + 10% HRA. The remuneration is competitive and aligned with project-based research roles.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) at NIFTEM?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Master's degree in relevant food science disciplines and a PhD in the mentioned field with publications. Minimum 2 years of experience in similar projects and laboratory animal handling is also required.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is 35 years. Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for women, SC, ST, OBC, and differently-abled candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF)?
faq.answer: The job location for the NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is Kundli, Haryana. This offers an opportunity to work in a prominent institute in the region.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF)?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience, followed by an interview round.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment. Candidates should still verify this detail in the official document.

faq.answer: The official website to apply for NIFTEM Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment is http://career.droniftem.com/. Candidates should visit this portal to access the application form and other relevant details.
